book.name: Qayeeng yeip yaing
book.title: Kilisi talex qayeeng xupekeing yeip yaing wou Yoan

content: Angela lim yuw is lul wei nilul o lim yuw

A xei dee ngandoung mama nge eivek tyoung gheyapu, om wong a etek mouyo. Angela lim yuw is lul mama wei nol lim yuw wei di lam yus o. Lam yus, en inyei lul mama nol on Anutu xe lalei vanei wei la tip lek o.

Me a xei lulti nambei mamileeng wei dewek o maleeng is nenyex. Xel moux alis vex wei wo vevek ghanaw leliy bemeeng is e xe tenu me ghanaw namba wei e lei di yeip lek o eno toungale wou mamileeng tiyon nenyawes me xel di zeim gita wei Anutu wong wou xel o.
Me wong saxoumb wei Mose yo, e Anutu xe xukxe, is saxoumb wei Sipsip Lingheing o,

content.text: “Tambiy Ngandoung Anutu, wa xe xuk nikanzekta
me nikanzek mama eno wang wong.
King wei xomaxoneing tembuing sapa yo
de wa xe kwakwa ne bombek me zonghek.
Tambiy Ngandoung, wa venaxow on vambuing.
Eti tyek se gyaleeng en wang me sanghoxe wa leim?
Xel tembuing sapa nei tyek nam me bong lalo wou wang
en wa xe xuk bombek eno lam dei yanyateiv woy.”

content: Ka tine lak veil a xei xomek vambuing no eivek tyoung gheyapu, inyei xomek sel wei petieing mindei eivek eno tax.
Angela lim yuw eno lam veil xomek vambuing is lul nol lim yuw. Xel vunek en vunekeing teleing wei vako yo, me siing de samyek let vivekwou bambound kanzek.
Woyom xel lul mapieing vey on eno ti wong dipek ghol lim yuw eno wou xel angela lim yuw on eno pup en Anutu xe lalei myavanei, wei e mindei luta luta yo.
Me xomek vambuing on eno pup en nenyex lu wei loum wou Anutu xe xeiyaing me nikanzek, me xelti se teyei bei na eivek xomek vambuing on qe ka lul nilul lim yuw wei angela lim yuw eno ema veil le.
